how.s3.p: If you want, turn on copying of CRYPTO NOVA in your own exchange account. The money always stays with you: CRYPTO NOVA has no access to it.
faq.a3: The app itself doesn't trade and has no access to your money. If you want, turn on copying of CRYPTO NOVA on the exchange: the exchange repeats the trades in your account. You can stop copying at any time.
faq.a5: The public portfolio is the system's demo accounts: futures and spot, $10,000 each, real prices, since {since}. Tests on history are not a promise about the future. Losing trades are published next to the winners.
cn.lead: Through the exchange's copy trading, with no API keys. The exchange itself repeats CRYPTO NOVA's trades — in your account, with the amount you choose.
cn.s1.p: It's a partner exchange that suits your country. The CRYPTO NOVA app shows you which one.
cn.s2.p: The link is in the CRYPTO NOVA app. Your terms on the exchange stay the same, and the exchange shares part of its fee with us.
cn.s3.p: The exchange's usual check: an ID document and a photo of your face.
cn.s4.p: Add USDT to your own exchange account. The money stays yours: CRYPTO NOVA can't withdraw it.
cn.s5.p: First in the CRYPTO NOVA app, then on the exchange:
cn.s6.p: On the exchange, open copy trading, choose CRYPTO NOVA and tap “Stop”. No new trades will open, and the money stays in your account.
cn.safe1.p: We never ask for keys, passwords, SMS codes or seed phrases.
cn.safe2.t: The money is in your account
cn.safe2.p: The exchange keeps it in your name. CRYPTO NOVA can't withdraw it.
cn.safe3.p: No subscriptions and no in-app purchases.
cn.risk: Copying is real trading: you can lose the money you put in. Before “Confirm”, the exchange shows the copy terms — read them. Past results don't guarantee future ones. Not financial advice.
